resources.string: StopIt watches which app comes to the front. When you open an app you picked, it plays the motivation clip over it first. Nothing is collected or sent anywhere.
StopIt needs its accessibility service to spot the apps you open and play the clip on top of them.
Switch greyed out? Open App info, tap ⋮ and choose Allow restricted settings, then try again.
